{{Quote|We've been such fools. Tarnis&mdash;he's a Sith!|Jonkan|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
'''Jonkan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A member of the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], a weapons development project, Jonkan was a member of the design team for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], but his superior, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], betrayed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the rest of the team before stealing the weapon. While Jonkan survived the attack by Tarnis, who was actually a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], the mortally-wounded scientist managed to help a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] track down Tarnis before his death.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tarnis tricked us. Said you Jedi were going to shut the project down. Told us to bring the Planet Prison here. Keep it safe. Thought we were saving the Republic. We brought Tarnis the prototype. He turned on us. Killed everyone.|Jonkan|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
[[File:Jonkan_dying.png|thumb|left|200px|Jonkan was fatally injured by Tarnis's attack.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Jonkan worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] development project, and was part of the five-man research team for the [[Planet Prison]] weapon on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Jonkan's superior, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], told the researchers that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were planning on shutting down the project, and Tarnis convinced his subordinates to bring him the prototype deep in the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]].<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

However, once they arrived, Tarnis revealed himself to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and brutally murdered the researchers before escaping with the prototype. Jonkan was the only one still alive when a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] [[Mission to Justicar territory|arrived]], and Jonkan struggled to tell the Jedi everything that had happened. When the Knight offered to take the scientist to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], Jonkan refused, saying there was no time, and told the Jedi to track the Planet Prison by its heat signature. Since the weapon needed [[Time/Legends|time]] to build up power, Jonkan urged the pair to destroy the weapon and save Coruscant. Thanks to Jonkan, the Knight was able to locate Tarnis and the weapon in the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Never meant to hurt anyone. Please, Tarnis took the Planet Prison. You have to stop him.|Jonkan|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
Dark-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Jonkan had gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]] by the time of the Cold War. The man was an intelligent scientist, but he trusted his superior, Tarnis, enough to believe that the Jedi would shut down the Planet Prison project. While dying, Jonkan felt that the safety of Coruscant and the Republic was more important than his own life, and he used his last moments to help the Jedi find the stolen weapon.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

==Equipment==
Jonkan wore brown clothing and a belt with pouches while working on the Planet Prison project.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jonkan first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the Jedi Knight-class mission "Tracking Down the Traitor." Jonkan starts the next mission in the storyline, "Race to the Ruins," by informing the player how to locate Tarnis.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />
